title: Inventario: physical inventory reconciliation between barcode terminals and ERP count tags (Visual Basic 6, 2002)
description:
Inventario fisico: riconciliazione tra terminali barcode e cartellini del gestionale

Inventario supports the yearly physical stock count. Lots counted in the warehouse with handheld barcode terminals are imported from fixed-width text files and matched with the count tags generated by the MFG/PRO ERP, so that missing, duplicated or misplaced lots can be found before the inventory is closed.

Designed and programmed by Massimo Sbarbaro in 2002 (Visual Basic 6). Published in 2026; all original data and the names of client organisations have been removed.
